name: AT & S Austria Technologie & Systemtechnik Aktiengesellschaft
summary: AT & S Austria Technologie & Systemtechnik Aktiengesellschaft, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, distributes, and sells printed circuit boards in Austria, Germany, rest of Europe, China, rest of Asia, and the Americas. The company operates through Electronics Solutions, Microelectronics, and Others segments. It offers integrated circuit substrates; printed circuit boards and modules; flexible and rigid-flex, thermally enhanced, high-density interconnect, substrate like, cavity, multilayer, and double-sided printed circuit boards; and test and reference boards.
